Short Description

Bowman has an opportunity for an Environmental Field Technician to join our team remotely.

At Bowman, we believe in creating opportunities for aspiring people to thrive and achieve ambitious goals. That’s why a career at Bowman is more than a job. It is an opportunity to be part of a diverse and engaged community of professionals, to be treated as a respected and valued member of a motivated team and to be empowered to do exceptional work that advances the best interest of everyone involved. We recognize the importance of creating a work environment that is both rewarding to our employees and supportive of our unwavering commitment to provide unparalleled service to our clients.

Purpose

This position involves the collection and compilation of environmental data from sites including bat and avian monitoring, under different stages or phases of environmental work processes.

Responsibilities

Leadership and Direction

Perform work under moderate supervision. Receive direction on moderately complex assignments, tasks, and execution. Work is frequently reviewed by more senior staff to ensure application of sound techniques and principles. Review work produced by junior staff for quality assurance.

At The Operational And Company Level

Work effectively with other departments and with employees at all levels.

Do the Work

Carefully operate field equipment and instruments.
Perform biological monitoring.
Perform wetland/water delineations.
Generate and log detailed field notes and data collection sheets.
Perform basic calculations related to sampling data.

Success Metrics and Competencies

Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
High degree of discretion and ability to manage highly confidential information.
High degree of motivation and problem-solving attitude.
Strong sense of urgency in responding to constituents.
Effective verbal and written communication skills.
Strong work ethic and commitment to quality.
Self-reliance and ability to operate independently with limited direction.
Ability to ask for additional direction and assistance when needed.
Strong element of quality control / attention to detail at all levels.
Commitment to promoting the reputation of the company through quality of work.
Desire to take on new tasks.
Aspirations to grow professionally and advance within the company.
Effective working relationship with internal leaders and peers, as well as external clients.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to effectively manage multiple time-sensitive tasks.
Data analysis and interpretation skills.

Qualifications

High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent commensurate experience required.
Associate's degree in environmental science, Geology, or related field preferred.
Bachelor's degree in environmental science, Geology, or related field a plus.
Three or more (3+) years of relevant industry-related experience.
Must have wetland/water delineation experience.
WPIT or PWS strongly preferred.
Must be willing to work in the field 75-90% of time.
Knowledge in the operation and use of field equipment, which includes, but is not limited to, 4x4 trucks, compass, tablet, range finder, etc.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
Must hold a valid state driver's license and successfully pass a motor vehicle check.

About Bowman

Are you ready to build a career that makes a lasting impact? At Bowman, our people are at the center of everything we do. We’re committed to creating an environment where employees can thrive both personally and professionally, while helping to shape the infrastructure of tomorrow.

A career at Bowman means being part of a collaborative, forward-thinking organization where innovation, inclusion, and growth are encouraged at every level. We offer competitive compensation, a supportive work environment, and benefits designed to help our employees succeed.

Salary and eligible variable compensation (if any) commensurate with experience. Hourly Range $25.25 - $31.50 and includes a comprehensive benefits package.

Our Comprehensive Benefits Package Includes

Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
401(k) retirement savings plan with company match
Paid time off, sick leave, and paid holidays
Tuition reimbursement and professional development support
Discretionary bonuses and other performance-based incentives
Employee Assistance Program (EAP), wellness initiatives, and employee discounts

Eligibility for certain benefits may vary based on position, location, and employment status.

Physical Demands and Working Environment

Primarily outdoor work environment which may include adverse weather conditions, varying temperatures, excessive noise, and/or potential hazards.
Mobility around a job/construction site to include walking, bending, crawling, climbing, squatting, or kneeling and wearing of required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
Frequent and prolonged use of data collection equipment and/or drones, necessitating walking the assigned study area to complete data collection over the course of several hours.
Primarily local travel during the business day, although some out-of-the-area and overnight travel may be required according to the needs of the business.
Occasional lifting or carrying up to 51-100 pounds.
Occasional pushing or pulling up to 51-100 pounds.
Occasional reaching outward or above shoulder.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Tatari is on a mission to revolutionize TV advertising. Founded in 2016 to help transform the antiquated world of TV advertising through the intelligent application of AI and machine learning, Tatari helps some of the world’s fastest growing brands including Chime, Calm, Tecovas, Manscaped, Saatva, and Liquid I.V ., reach their customers using linear and streaming TV ads. Our platform combines sophisticated media buying with proprietary analytics to turn TV advertising into an automated, digital-like experience, enabling businesses of any size to advertise on TV.
That approach has earned Tatari broad industry recognition, including being named Best CTV AdTech Platform in the 8th annual MarTech Breakthrough Awards , as well as honors from Digiday (Best Connected TV Platform), AdExchanger (Most Innovative TV Advertising Technology), and Business Insider (Hottest AdTech Companies). Tatari has also been recognized as the Best Place to Work by Inc. Magazine . Backed by an executive team of former founders and senior leaders from companies including Shazam, TrueCar, AdapTV, LiveRail, Amazon, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and Yahoo, Tatari continues to scale rapidly as TV advertising enters its next major era.
We are looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be the technical authority bridging our clients and internal teams—owning complex B2B integrations end-to-end, mentoring junior engineers, and influencing the long-term technical direction of our solutions practice. You will work directly with strategic clients to understand integration requirements, lead architecture-level decisions across our data and tooling systems, and drive cross-functional initiatives that raise the bar for the entire team. Beyond execution, you will proactively identify product gaps, propose improvements to our technical stack, and ensure your team has the knowledge and resources to succeed. Familiarity with the AdTech ecosystem—including ad measurement, attribution, pixel/tag implementation, or privacy-safe tracking—is a strong advantage in this role.
Description:

Lead complex client integrations end-to-end, owning technical decisions from discovery through production and serving as the primary technical contact for strategic accounts
Design, build, and maintain public-facing Python SDKs and robust APIs that simplify integration workflows and abstract complex data management processes for clients; own API versioning, documentation, and authentication flows
Investigate and resolve complex client-side implementation issues and data pipeline failures; drive root-cause analysis and implement systemic fixes rather than one-off patches; act as the escalation point from junior SEs and partner with engineering to drive resolution of issues requiring deeper platform changes
Identify data quality gaps, operational pain points, and product improvement opportunities—including gaps related to privacy-safe measurement and cookieless tracking—and synthesize these into prioritized recommendations that inform the short- and long-term roadmap
Actively mentor junior and mid-level Solutions Engineers, providing technical guidance, code review, and support for their growth
Contribute to tooling, tech stack, and architecture discussions and decisions; propose larger-scale changes that meaningfully improve the technical health of our systems
Collaborate with your manager on team goal-setting, aligning team objectives to company priorities, and ensuring critical knowledge is distributed across the team
Partner with sales on technical discovery, RFPs, and proof-of-concept engagements for strategic prospective accounts

Qualifications:

5+ years experience as a software engineer, Python preferred
5+ years working with data systems, including hands-on experience with SQL; familiarity with AWS (S3, CloudFront), PostgreSQL, and streaming data pipelines (Kafka, Storm, or similar) preferred
Fluent AI-assisted development: you regularly use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar as a core part of your workflow — writing, debugging, refactoring, and accelerating engineering work
Demonstrated ability to drive complex, ambiguous technical projects independently and see them through to production
Strong understanding of API architectural patterns (REST, GraphQL, AWS API Gateway, etc.) and experience building and maintaining robust client-facing SDKs and integration tools
Proven experience designing and building workflow automation using tools like n8n, Zapier, or similar platforms; you think architecture-first, not just configuration
Exceptional communication skills — equally comfortable leading technical design discussions with engineers and translating complex concepts to non-technical clients or stakeholders
Proven ability to manage multiple clients and workstreams simultaneously, often under tight timelines, without sacrificing quality
Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to the technical growth of a team
Awareness of digital advertising measurement, privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA), and cookieless/server-side tracking trends is a strong plus

Benefits

Total compensation ($140,000 - $170,000)
Equity compensation
Health insurance coverage for you and your dependents
401K, FSA, and commuter benefits
$150 monthly spending account
$1,000 annual continued education benefit
$500 Newbie Productivity Perk
Unlimited PTO and sick days
Monthly Company Wellness Day Off
Snacks, drinks, and catered lunches at the office
Team building events 
Hybrid RTO of 2 days per week in office.

At Tatari, we believe in the importance of cultivating teams with diverse backgrounds and offering equal opportunities to all. We strive to create a welcoming, inclusive environment where every team member feels valued and diversity is celebrated.

A unit of The University of Kansas (KU), the Kansas Law Enforcement Training Center serves as the central agency for all law enforcement training in the State of Kansas. KLETC manages a $12 million annual budget, 65 authorized FTE staff (augmented by more than 400 contract/adjunct staff annually), and trains nearly 15,000 students annually in residential, online, and outreach programs. Position Overview

A unit of The University of Kansas (KU), the Kansas Law Enforcement Training Center serves as the central agency for all law enforcement training in the State of Kansas. KLETC manages a $12 million annual budget, 65 authorized FTE staff (augmented by more than 400 contract/adjunct staff annually), and trains nearly 15,000 students annually in residential, online, and outreach programs. KLETC serves 437 recognized law enforcement and police agencies in Kansas, providing basic training and continuing education programs throughout each fiscal year.

The Center for Public Safety Leadership (CPSL) brings the resources of KLETC and KU together to develop law enforcement leadership training, education, and assessments.

In addition to a competitive salary, KU offers great benefits to employees such as paid vacation, sick leave, ten paid holidays, plus one discretionary day, a retirement program, medical and dental insurance, life and disability insurance, other benefit plan options and State of Kansas discounts offered by various vendors. KU also offers employees education and professional development opportunities.

Position Overview

The Education Program Coordinator provides comprehensive program coordination, administrative, and operational support for KLETC’s Professional Continuing Education (PCE) unit and the CPSL. This position provides support for the planning, development, implementation, delivery, and evaluation of professional development and leadership education programs that support law enforcement and public safety professionals.

Working collaboratively with faculty, staff, instructors, and external partners, the coordinator supports a broad portfolio of educational initiatives, including leadership development programs, executive education offerings, assessments, conferences, workshops, and other CPSL activities. Responsibilities include coordinating program logistics, maintaining stakeholder communications, and tracking program data and outcomes, ensuring a high-quality participant experience.

The Education Program Coordinator serves as a key point of contact for students, instructors, agency representatives, and other stakeholders, contributing to the successful delivery of programs while advancing the missions of both KLETC PCE and the CPSL. This position exercises independent judgment, manages multiple priorities simultaneously, and supports continuous improvement efforts to enhance program quality, organizational effectiveness, and service to Kansas and regional public safety agencies.

Job Description

45% Coordination of Training Events:

Coordinate the development, marketing and delivery of law enforcement continuing education and specialized law enforcement seminars, courses, classes, workshops, schools and other training-related events being held at regional training sites across Kansas.
Executes KLETC and CPSL’s business strategy by offering seminars, workshops, schools, courses and classes on a variety of law enforcement related topics. This includes coordinating and overseeing other law enforcement-related training events as identified by the management team.
Research and develop law enforcement continuing education training classes and seminars for local, state and federal law enforcement officers.
Coordinate with faculty, consultants, coaches and subject matter experts involved in CPSL programming.
Coordinates participant communications, including enrollment information, pre-course materials, program updates, and post-program follow-up.
Administers participant assessments, surveys, and evaluation instruments for leadership development programs, executive education offerings, and other KLETC and CPSL initiatives.
Collects, tracks, and analyzes program evaluation data and participant feedback to support continuous improvement, program effectiveness, and reporting requirements.
Determines audio-visual equipment needs, instructional supplies, participant supplies and various staff/instructional needs for training events.
Recruits subject matter experts as instructors and negotiates terms of contracts.
Directs and manages logistics at the training program event. Activities include but are not limited to registrations, classroom set-up, instructional needs and primary contact with regard to participant concerns.
Manages program assessment by conducting, interpreting and reporting evaluations from training events.
Ensures regional training site is maintained and prepared for training. Prepare reports, correspondence, charts, graphs and other documents related to assigned responsibilities and duties.

20% Representation in Law Enforcement Community with focus on Northeast Region:

Perform administrative duties in support of the KLETC and CPSL mission.
Establish short- and long-term goals relative to assigned areas of responsibility.
Actively participate in partnerships with the Kansas law enforcement community and professional law enforcement associations as directed by the management team
Regularly schedule and facilitate regional training council meetings.
Working with event planning committees to develop and implement law enforcement association conference programs that occur within regions.
Coordinate distance learning programs, classes, courses, etc. with other law enforcement agencies or organizations to ensure maximum customer service.
Enhancing the external relations section to reflect partnerships with law enforcement agencies, professional associations, higher education partners, and other stakeholders at both the regional and statewide levels.

Understanding of systems and network operations, and applications.
Understand simulator technology.
Develop and implement technological initiatives to support training.
Enrolls students in classes.
Reviews registrations to ensure accuracy and contacts enrollees if additional information is needed.
Communicate with students, agency heads, etc. to answer questions or provide needed assistance regarding PCE and CPSL classes.
Schedules classes in coordination with other KLETC and CPSL training sites.

Less than 25% travel.

Three years’ experience in the management, coordination or delivery of education and/or training programs.

Excellent communication skills as evidenced by work history and application materials.
